title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-10
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith; MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: Source: taped and remastered by Monte Barry; Sony TC 2850SD portable stereo cassette recorder Sony ECM 99 single-point stereo mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up FOB center infield, between sbd platform and stage platform;

ai_review.summary: Nice‑sounding audience recording capturing a great show highlighted by a soaring Birdsong jam and an unforgettable third set
ai_review.review: The AUD tape is praised as one of the nicest‑sounding audience recordings, with Charlie's transfer delivering clear detail despite some loss of the live tightness. Musically the concert shines – fans rave about the extended Birdsong jam, a goose‑bumps‑inducing Morning Dew, a fireworks‑capped Playin’ in the Band and a powerful Dark Star that makes the third set the night’s high point.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers are enthusiastic about both performance and sound quality; the show is described as great with standout jams, while the audience recording is noted as very good though not a studio‑level master.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the nicest‑sounding AUD tapes; clear enough for enjoyable listening, with Charlie's transfer noted as solid despite some inevitable loss of live tightness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First two sets solid but a notch below the previous night; third set steals the show with an epic Birdsong jam and dark, exploratory playing that leaves a lasting impression.

band_member_comments.Jerry: General praise for the band being "ON" and tight, implying strong Garcia guitar work.
